findings.problem: web-client-adapt is timing-sensitive: it gives the web boot a hard 60 s deadline to PRINT its auth token (`web-client-adapt.mjs:154` bootDeadline) and then asserts tokenSeen/cookieSession. Under concurrent load (my gate battery running in parallel) the boot printed its token at ~69 s, so the case went red twice (2026-09-11T06:21:10Z and 06:30:49Z) with an identical 5-line boot log and the same code path; a solo re-run at 06:33:32Z PASSED with tokenSeen/cookieSession/bootEntry/clientJs all ok. Not a wave-2 regression — a load-dependent flake.
findings.requiredFix: Case-level hardening (skills/**): widen the boot deadline or treat a late token as a retry rather than a hard failure.

findings.problem: In a layout where codegraph is unresolvable (packed `file:` install without optionalDependencies, no .toolchain, not on PATH) and $HOME/.mpd is not writable, the codegraph MCP child now reaches the adopted provisioning path and dies with an uncaught `ENOENT: mkdir '<home>/.mpd/codegraph'` instead of the previous graceful 'unavailable' stub (the old wrong env pin made resolution.source === 'env', which skips provisioning). Observed in mcp-call at 2026-09-11T06-21-10Z.
findings.requiredFix: Out of t9's scope (adopted serve.js + QA HOME isolation). Recommend a follow-up: either make mcp-call sandbox HOME (AGENTS.md §7) so the provider path is exercised in a writable home, or have the launcher fall back to a `runUnavailableMcp`-style stub when resolution fails and provisioning is impossible.

findings.problem: The QA dev-flavor patch rewrite (`skills/dsh-qa/scripts/preset-register.mjs:30-36` devPatch + `mcpEnv` 38-46, duplicated in `rtl-verif.mjs:69-77,168,176`) leaves the `baseUrl + "/node_modules/"` operand in front of the checkout path, so MCP row args become `<baseUrl>/node_modules/<abs-repo-path>/...`; they only resolve because `MPD_DSH_*_CLI` is pre-set. With the CLI pins unset (the whole point of B8) the MCP children die with MODULE_NOT_FOUND — reproduced in my first mount boot. `mcpEnv()` also still pre-pins MPD_AST_GREP_SG_PATH to the deprecated `.bin/sg` wrapper.
findings.requiredFix: Out of t9's scope (skills/**, VENDOR_LOCK-fingerprinted; t7 terminal). Recommend a scoped follow-up that rewrites the whole operand (as my b8-mount-boot.mjs does) and drops the two binary pins from mcpEnv.

findings.problem: mcp-call spawns dsh with the real HOME and copies only `.credentials.yaml`; under this environment the real `~/.mpd` is a read-only filesystem, so any plugin touching the home fails, and live LLM turns end at MISSING_CREDENTIAL (AGENTS.md §7 requires settings.yaml for gateway homes).
findings.requiredFix: Case-level fix (skills/**): sandbox HOME and copy settings.yaml when present.
